scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: Two sets of three allegorical sculptures complete the two primary facades and were designed by Jon Magnus Jonson (1893–1947).

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: The facility was dedicated as the "Purdue Hall of Music" on May 3–4, 1940, and was renamed in honor of Elliott in 1958.
